personas.title: Lead Data & Analytics Engineer
personas.description: Manages dataset generation, Medallion Bronze/Silver/Gold ingestion, quality validation, ML pipeline, and data monitoring.

personas.title: Attending Physician / Specialist
personas.description: Accesses patient clinical 360, diagnostic trends, lab outcomes, predictive readmission risks, and prescriptive clinical plans.

personas.title: Executive Hospital Administrator
personas.description: Enterprise-level operational intelligence: occupancy, revenue, readmission rates, resource surge forecasts, and capacity planning.

personas.title: Chief Clinical Pharmacist
personas.description: Monitors drug inventory, stockout risks, prescription utilization, demand forecasts, and procurement recommendations.

personas.title: Laboratory Operations Specialist
personas.description: Tracks investigation throughput, critical abnormal result alerts, analyzer turnaround time, and staffing demand forecasts.

personas.title: Front-Desk Patient Flow Coordinator
personas.description: Manages appointment bookings, cancellations, check-in flow, and waiting times. Strictly restricted from clinical diagnoses and lab records.

personas.title: Enterprise IT & Security Administrator
personas.description: Monitors system health, database schemas, pipeline status, audit event streams, and security access logs.
